info.title: Inventory API
info.description: Stock management API. Breaking changes ship under a new URI version (`/api/v2`); `/api/v1` remains stable. Prefer OpenAPI (`/api/docs`) for contracts; `docs/FRONTEND_API.md` is the human guide.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the refresh JWT — never store the raw token.

unit.description: Compatibility display symbol; stockUnit is the authoritative definition.

isPhantom.description:
Phantom item: when used as a BOM component, requirements pass through to its
default BOM (unless the BOM line overrides isPhantom).

imageUrl.description: Absolute (or relative) URL for API clients — set in service, not persisted.

reserved.description:
Qty committed but still on-hand (holds / pending transfers).
Available = quantity − reserved.

reorderPoint.description: Alert when quantity falls to or below this level (per location). Null = no alert.

parentId.description: Parent warehouse/showroom when type is BIN (putaway target).

userLocations.description: Empty = no locations; locations.all grants business-wide access.

locationIds.description: Empty / omitted = no locations unless the role grants locations.all.

parentId.description: Required when type is BIN (parent warehouse/showroom).

purchasePrice.description: Optional unit cost when increasing stock (FOUND / OPENING / RETURN).

isPhantom.description: Phantom / non-stocked assembly (pass-through in BOMs by default).

quantity.description: Quantity of component required to make 1 finished unit.

isPhantom.description:
Phantom / non-stocked: do not issue this component; explode its default BOM
into the parent order (industry kit / phantom assembly).

isDefault.description: Only one active default BOM per finished item.

yieldPercent.description: Expected yield % of finished output (100 = no loss).

isPhantom.description: Pass-through component (do not stock-issue; explode child BOM).
Pass-through component (do not stock-issue; explode child BOM).

itemId.description: Inquiry line item to produce; defaults to first line.

bomId.description: Defaults to the item's default active BOM.

issuedValue.description: Cumulative inventory value of issued qty (for actual FG costing).

saleId.description: Optional sales order / sale this production fulfills.

finishedLocationId.description: Finished-goods receipt location (defaults to component location).

materialsReserved.description: True after release reserved component qty.

bankName.description: Financial institution / provider (e.g. "Commercial Bank of Ethiopia").

accountHolderName.description: Name on the account (business or person).

readyForSaleAt.description: Set when linked production completes — FG ready to sell/deliver.

finishedLocationId.description: FG receipt location; defaults to locationId.

saleId.description: Link to an existing sale this production fulfills.

lines.description: If omitted, issues all remaining required material.

autoIssue.description: If true, auto-issue any missing materials needed for this completion qty. Default true.

shipImmediately.description:
When true, ship + receive immediately (legacy one-shot).
Default false → PENDING with source reservation.

unitCost.description: Snapshot of source unit cost when shipped (IN_TRANSIT).

contactName.description: Derived from the linked customer or submitting employee for internal requests.

subject.description: Generated from requested products when omitted.

lines.description:
Preferred: multiple catalog items of interest.
Legacy: single `itemId` still accepted and stored as one line.

convertedSaleId.description: Legacy clients may echo the unchanged link. It cannot be assigned or cleared here.

Preferred: multiple catalog items of interest.
Legacy: single `itemId` still accepted and stored as one line.

name.description: Short label shown in lists and payment dropdowns.

lotNumber.description: Optional lot; when omitted issues use FEFO if lots exist.

inquiryId.description: Close the MTO loop: sale from this inquiry.

productionOrderId.description: Prefer FG from this completed production order.
